description: This Java class 'VerifyPickSessionRow' models a row in a shipment verification process within the OFBiz framework. It contains fields representing order and shipment details, provides getters and setters for these fields, and includes methods to issue items to shipments and update picklist items. The class facilitates handling of shipment verification data and related operations.

classes.name: VerifyPickSessionRow
classes.description: A serializable Java class representing a shipment pick session row, encapsulating details about order items and shipment verification, with methods to issue items to the shipment and update picklist items.

methods.name: getOrderItemSeqId
methods.description: Returns the order item sequence ID.

methods.name: getShipGroupSeqId
methods.description: Returns the shipment group sequence ID.

methods.name: getReadyToVerifyQty
methods.description: Returns the quantity ready to verify.

methods.name: setReadyToVerifyQty
methods.description: Sets the quantity ready to verify.

methods.name: setShipmentItemSeqId
methods.description: Sets the shipment item sequence ID.

methods.name: getShipmentItemSeqId
methods.description: Returns the shipment item sequence ID.

methods.name: setInvoiceItemSeqId
methods.description: Sets the invoice item sequence ID.

methods.name: getInvoiceItemSeqId
methods.description: Returns the invoice item sequence ID.

methods.name: getOrderItem
methods.description: Returns the corresponding order item GenericValue.

methods.name: isSameItem
methods.description: Checks if another row refers to the same inventory item, order, and shipment group.

methods.name: issueItemToShipment
methods.description: Issues the specified quantity of the item to a shipment, updates the picklist status if applicable, and manages shipment item IDs.
